title: Bound temporal outer banks for the owned write aggregate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On the exact word, replacing owner 1531's paid 594→117→534 route with one direct lift would require reproducing a private two-write aggregate. Grant every unchanged, live cocharted donor between the two original MOVE clocks, including the banks before and after the chosen replacement MOVE. Across both switch schedules, all 4,494 bank cuts and 7,163 donor incidences are exhausted. Input 244 has response zero on every donor and the old owner diagonal, but −1/2 on the required signed aggregate. Both schedules are excluded. No cases remain unresolved in this scope.

The two schedules share the same paid pair. The optimistic one-edit gross upper across 17 calls is 0.154513811062998 raw units. The verified saving is zero.

## Task and overlap

Use [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7378](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7378) checks the two fixed endpoint banks. This result closes the entire variable-time union under the same original switch clocks and retained donor itineraries. The package is the only new commit, stacked on the two existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned-outer-temporal-aggregate-bound/replay.py
```

The clean replay authenticates the word and predecessor quote, reproduces all three receipts and rejects three altered inputs. Independent sparse reverse checks confirm all nine forward bank aliases, the old signed source responses and the exact separation. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, six navigation tests and Git-free export replay passed locally. The necessary support failure ended the construction test.

## Credit

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact word and signed caller. #7378 supplies the fixed-bank exclusion and aggregate. #7354 and #7355 supply the owned chronology and sole-write method. #7362 and #7298 supply the signed pricing. An earlier #7111 producer/recovery proposal uses the same paid pair under a different contract. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A different switch clock or changed donor itinerary would need a full compatible quote and a new signed support test before construction.
